carousel.title: TCS Partners With Anthropic to Build Enterprise AI Unit, Arms 50,000 Staff With Claude
carousel.excerpt: India's largest IT services firm creates a dedicated business unit for Anthropic's Claude models, targeting regulated sectors from finance to healthcare.
carousel.image_caption: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, whose company has partnered with TCS to scale enterprise AI deployment. The deal makes India's largest IT firm a Global Premier Partner in the Claude Partner Network.
carousel.nri_angle: The partnership signals a fundamental shift in India's IT sector from labour-intensive services to AI-enabled solutions, directly affecting thousands of TCS employees in diaspora offices across the US, UK, and Europe.

carousel.title: India's Middle East Oil Imports Plunge 27% as Hormuz Crisis Forces Shift to Russia
carousel.excerpt: Russian crude now accounts for 41% of India's oil imports after Strait of Hormuz disruptions cut Middle East supplies, with refiners also turning to Brazil, Venezuela and Angola.
carousel.image_caption: A supertanker at sea loaded with crude oil. India's reliance on Russian and Latin American crude surged in the April-June quarter as Strait of Hormuz disruptions cut Middle East supplies by 27%.
carousel.nri_angle: India's surging oil import bill and supply chain disruption threaten higher fuel prices and inflation that directly affect household budgets and remittance purchasing power for the diaspora.
